questions.q: What does a functional consultant primarily do?
options: Understand business processes deeply and configure Oracle Fusion Cloud, mainly through Setup and Maintenance rather than code
Write custom Groovy scripts for every business rule
Manage Oracle's data center hardware
Only perform data migrations using FBDI
questions.explain: A functional consultant configures the system to support business processes, working mainly through Setup and Maintenance rather than writing code.

questions.q: Which of these tasks belongs to a technical consultant rather than a functional consultant?
options: Running fit-gap analysis sessions with stakeholders
Building integrations using REST APIs and Oracle Integration Cloud
Deciding how the Chart of Accounts should be structured
Leading a Conference Room Pilot
questions.explain: Building integrations with REST APIs/OIC is technical work; fit-gap sessions, Chart of Accounts design, and CRPs are functional consultant activities.

options: A security role for functional consultants
A type of quarterly update
File-Based Data Import, a tool used for mass-loading data, typically technical consultant work
The name of Oracle's home page widget
questions.explain: FBDI (File-Based Data Import) is used for mass data loads, falling on the technical side of implementation work alongside HDL.

questions.q: According to the lesson, is the line between functional and technical consultants perfectly rigid in practice?
options: Yes, functional and technical consultants never overlap in skills
No, because functional consultants are technically not allowed in Setup and Maintenance
Yes, Oracle legally prohibits consultants from doing both
No — many functional consultants pick up data-load and API knowledge, and many technical consultants develop process judgment, and the gap keeps narrowing with low-code tools
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly notes the roles blur in practice, and that gap has narrowed further as Oracle invests in low-code extension tools.

questions.q: Which side of this distinction does the Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant career path primarily prepare students for?
options: Functional, with some technical working knowledge added in later courses
Purely technical, with no functional content at all
Neither — it is unrelated to this distinction
Equally split 50/50 from the very first course
questions.explain: The path's title and its emphasis on accounting, process, and configuration point to the functional side, with technical courses later adding working knowledge rather than a separate track.
